source_policies.rule: DOJ-generated website information is public domain unless otherwise indicated; citation is appropriate. DOJ seals/logos/official insignia require advance written authorization. Third-party-attributed photos/graphics require permission from the original source.
source_policies.operational_rule: Use DOJ facts/text as source material and rebuild them into original Editorial Renaissance Motion evidence cards. Do not reproduce DOJ seals/logos. Do not assume third-party photos are cleared.

source_policies.rule: FBI-provided information not otherwise attributed is public information and may be distributed/copied, but seal and name/initial use must not create an impression of FBI approval or endorsement.
source_policies.operational_rule: Use plain-text source attribution only; no FBI seal/logo; no styling that implies endorsement.

source_policies.rule: Treat IC3 factual guidance as FBI-origin public information unless attributed otherwise.
source_policies.operational_rule: Use data-card paraphrase and plain-text source label; do not use FBI/IC3 seals as decorative branding.

source_policies.rule: Natural Earth vector and raster map data are public domain and may be modified and used commercially.
